title: Ubud Waterfalls, Sacred Monkey Forest & Rice Terraces
lead: Experience three sides of Ubud in one private journey: tropical waterfalls, playful macaques in a sacred forest and Bali's iconic green rice terraces.
summary: Three sides of Ubud in a relaxed private day: lush falls, forest life and iconic rice landscapes.
introTitle: Discover Ubud at your own pace
intro: This private Ubud day trip brings together nature, wildlife and classic Balinese scenery without the pace of a large group.
highlights: Walk through Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary.
Enjoy private transport and flexible pacing.
stops: Ubud waterfalls
Head into Ubud's tropical landscape for a waterfall stop.
Sacred Monkey Forest
Explore one of Ubud's best-known natural and cultural landmarks.
Tegallalang rice terraces
See the terraced fields carved into the valley and learn how rice cultivation shapes rural life.

title: Besakih Temple, Sidemen & Gembleng Private Day Trip
lead: Discover Bali's spiritual heart at Besakih, slow down among Sidemen's rice terraces and traditional weaving, then cool off at hidden Gembleng Waterfall.
summary: Temple heritage, rice-country scenery, traditional weaving and a hidden waterfall.
introTitle: A quieter journey through East Bali
intro: This private day trip combines one of Bali's most important temple complexes with the rural scenery and living traditions of Sidemen.
highlights: Experience a short traditional weaving session.
Enjoy a relaxed private day trip.
stops: Besakih Temple
Explore the extensive temple complex on the slopes of Mount Agung.
Sidemen rice terraces & weaving
Continue into Sidemen's countryside for rice-field views and a closer look at traditional textile craft.
Gembleng Waterfall
End among tropical greenery at Gembleng, known for its natural pools and peaceful hillside setting.

title: Lahangan Sweet, Amed Salt & Taman Ujung
lead: Go beyond the classic East Bali route with Mount Agung viewpoints, a traditional coastal craft and one of Karangasem's most elegant royal water palaces.
summary: Big Mount Agung views, coastal tradition and one of Bali's most beautiful royal gardens.
introTitle: East Bali beyond the usual photo stops
intro: This private route is built around Lahangan Sweet rather than the crowded Lempuyang photo gate.
highlights: Take in Mount Agung views from Lahangan Sweet.
Discover traditional Amed salt-making when available.
Walk through Taman Ujung Water Palace.
stops: Lahangan Sweet
Start with one of East Bali's striking mountain viewpoints.
Amed traditional salt
Continue toward the coast to see a long-standing Amed tradition when conditions allow.
Taman Ujung Water Palace
Explore the former royal complex with its pools, bridges and gardens.

title: Private Balinese Flute Workshop in Ubud
lead: Step inside Bali's musical culture through bamboo craftsmanship, hands-on flute playing, a studio visit and a private live performance.
summary: Step into the studio, meet the artist and discover the craft and sound of the Balinese flute.
intro: This private experience brings you closer to the sound and craft of the Balinese flute.
highlights: Meet and greet at the music studio.
Watch how a traditional bamboo flute is crafted.
stops: Private workshop
Meet the artist and discover the craft behind the instrument.
Learn to play
Try basic Balinese flute techniques in a private setting.
Studio & performance
Explore the studio and enjoy a live musical performance.
